scope: Own two same-front shell channels and integral frame ribs per slot; no connector key, contact deletion, PCB change or vendor mating claim.
key_locations: Mirror the listed left-side geometry in the socket's YZ plane. Both keys remain at the SAME front Y, not diagonally opposite corners;180degree reversal moves both card channels to the rear.
leaf_relief_scope: Closed-leaf coordinates relative to the socket centre; mirrored at the other end. Each relief opens a working edge but retains its hinge ear and the first3.4mm of leaf next to the axis.

references.use: Exact selected part,2017 drawing. Socket mouth is earlier than the4.06mm-deep contact point; blocking above its mouth does not depend on a modeled spring.
Supplier between-contact key is a separate accessory with its own card-cutout interface. Not adopted or recreated here; all62 terminals remain.
Explicit complementary stock/clearance geometry, rather than an intersecting or visually keyed assembly.
Production open CAD: positive retained stock with explicit subtractive mating, tool and fastener clearances. No geometry copied.

not_proven: The declared manufacturing and assembly tolerances are design requirements, not measured process capability.
Dimensional stacks are bounded analytically and tilted entry checked at declared native poses. Elastic bypass, fracture strength and repeated wear require physical qualification.
The shell return wall and relieved leaf require manufacturability review and a prototype. No fabrication or powered insertion approval.
